Dear ⟦name|Juniper⟧,

On behalf of Brightwater Analytics, Inc. (the "Company"), I am delighted to offer you the position
of Senior Product Designer, reporting to ⟦name|Will Baker⟧, Director of Design. This letter sets out
the principal terms of our offer.

1. Start Date. Your anticipated first day of employment will be Monday, November 16, 2026, or
another date we agree in writing. Please arrive at our Austin office at 9:00 a.m. and ask the front
desk for ⟦name|Marisol⟧ from People Ops.

2. Compensation. Your starting base salary will be $148,000.00 per year, less applicable
withholdings, paid semi-monthly on the 15th and the last business day of each month. This position
is classified as exempt under the Fair Labor Standards Act.

3. Sign-On Bonus. You will receive a one-time sign-on bonus of $10,000, payable with your first
regular paycheck. If you resign or are terminated for Cause within 12 months of your Start Date,
you agree to repay a pro-rated portion within 30 days.

4. Equity. Subject to approval by the Board of Directors, you will be granted 6,500 restricted
stock units ("RSUs") under the Company's 2021 Equity Incentive Plan. The RSUs will vest over four
years: 25% on the first anniversary of the vesting commencement date and the remainder in equal
quarterly installments thereafter. Your grant number will be assigned in Carta after Board approval.

5. Benefits. You will be eligible for the Company's medical, dental and vision plans from your
first day and for the 401(k) plan (4% match) after 30 days. You will accrue 20 days of paid time
off per year, plus 11 Company holidays.

6. Employee Number. For payroll and systems access your employee number will be ⟦employee id|BWA-20931⟧.
Please have it handy when you complete your onboarding tasks in Rippling.

7. Contingencies. This offer is contingent upon (a) satisfactory completion of a background check,
which our vendor will initiate once you sign the enclosed Disclosure and Authorization; (b) your
execution of the Company's Proprietary Information and Inventions Assignment Agreement; and (c)
verification of your identity and employment authorization on Form I-9 within three business days
of your Start Date.

8. At-Will Employment. Your employment with the Company will be "at will," meaning that either you
or the Company may end it at any time, with or without cause or notice. This letter, together with
the PIIA, is the entire agreement between us on these subjects.

This offer remains open until 5:00 p.m. Central Time on Friday, October 23, 2026. If you have any
questions, call me directly at ⟦phone number|512-555-0163⟧, or reach out to ⟦name|Will⟧ at ⟦phone number|512.555.0119⟧ -
he is excited to walk you through the team's roadmap.

Sincerely,

⟦name|Rosalind Achebe-Pruitt⟧
Chief People Officer
⟦email address|rachebe-pruitt@brightwater-analytics.com⟧

cc: Personnel file; ⟦name|W. Baker⟧
